title: Breadcrumb
description: Where the page sits: a trail of links ending with the current page. Long trails collapse their middle into a “…” menu.
when: Detail pages deep in a hierarchy (Kho › Vật liệu › PLA đen).
a11y: A nav landmark (“Đường dẫn”) with an ordered list; the last item has aria-current="page".

examples.title: Collapsed
examples.description: More items than maxItems keep the first and the last two; the rest open from “…”.
